fieldValues.title: Nightly unattended lane
fieldValues.description: Take open issues labelled lane:unattended and ready, up to 3 per run, and ship each as a pull request that the owner reviews: claim, guard, implement, gates by exit code, reviewer subagent, PR, run report. Never merges.
fieldValues.done_when: Each issue taken has a PR with gate results and a run report comment, or a needs-input stop with the exact question; the summary comment is on semanticops.com#33. An empty queue is reported there.
